bio.text: Gabe Amo represents Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House.

He previously served as Special Assistant to the President and Deputy Director of the White House Office of Intergovernmental Affairs under President Biden, and as Director of Public Engagement and Community Affairs for Gov. Gina Raimondo.
A native of Pawtucket, Amo graduated from Wheaton College (Massachusetts) and received a Marshall Scholarship to study at the University of Oxford.
